# Update m3: properly resolve data-toc-label placeholders
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['cat', 'markdown/extensions/toc.py'],
    capture_output=True, text=True
)
content = result.stdout

old_section = '''                if int(el.tag[-1]) >= self.toc_top and int(el.tag[-1]) <= self.toc_bottom:
                    raw_label = el.attrib.get('data-toc-label')
                    if raw_label:
                        # Use stashedHTML2text to convert escape sequences back to HTML,
                        # then strip tags for plain text name
                        name = stashedHTML2text(code_escape(raw_label), self.md, strip_entities=False)
                        name = striptags(name)
                    else:
                        name = striptags(text)
                    # Unescape markdown escape sequences in name (like original code)
                    name = unescape(name)
                    toc_tokens.append({
                        'level': int(el.tag[-1]),
                        'id': el.attrib["id"],
                        'name': name,
                        'html': inner_html,
                        'data-toc-label': raw_label
                    })'''

new_section = '''                if int(el.tag[-1]) >= self.toc_top and int(el.tag[-1]) <= self.toc_bottom:
                    raw_label = el.attrib.get('data-toc-label')
                    if raw_label:
                        # Resolve HTML placeholders and preserve entities for data-toc-label
                        resolved_label = stashedHTML2text(code_escape(raw_label), self.md, strip_entities=False)
                        # Strip tags for name
                        name = striptags(resolved_label)
                        # Store the resolved label (with entities preserved)
                        data_toc_label = resolved_label
                    else:
                        name = striptags(text)
                        data_toc_label = None
                    # Unescape markdown escape sequences in name (like original code)
                    name = unescape(name)
                    toc_tokens.append({
                        'level': int(el.tag[-1]),
                        'id': el.attrib["id"],
                        'name': name,
                        'html': inner_html,
                        'data-toc-label': data_toc_label
                    })'''

new_content = content.replace(old_section, new_section)

with open('markdown/extensions/toc.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(new_content)

print("Updated run method for m3")
